parameters.name: template
parameters.value: System/User/Assistant prompt with sequence embeddings and CELL DESCRIPTION output

parameters.name: order
parameters.value: System message, then User sequence embeddings, then Assistant CELL DESCRIPTION

evidence.quote: we adopted a specific instruction-following prompt structure that integrates a system message and the contextualized gene embeddings:

System : You are a scientific assistant specialized in cell description predictions. Given the cell sentence embeddings, describe it clearly and concisely in professional language. User : Sequence embeddings: H g, 1 | H g, 2 | ... | H g,N Assistant : < CELL DESCRIPTION >

decisions.rationale: R6: an instruction-following prompt structure is text serialization with the documented system, user, and assistant order.

evidence.quote: The model takes single-cell RNA-seq profiles as input

decisions.rationale: R0: this element names the input data object without describing a transformation.

evidence.quote: We chose Geneformer (Theodoris et al., 2023b; Chen et al., 2024), a transformer-based model pre-trained specifically on single-cell genomics data on masked gene prediction task, as our cell encoder
Geneformer produces a sequence of N gene embeddings

decisions.rationale: R3: Geneformer is a named pretrained encoder module.

evidence.quote: This module consists of a two-layer feedforward network with non-linear activation that projects each gene embedding to the natural language semantic space.
The adapter module remains trainable in both training strategies

decisions.rationale: R3: an adapter module that projects gene embeddings into language-model space is represented as a learned project operation.

decisions.chain_element: projected into the LLM's input embedding space

evidence.quote: Here, H g, 1 | H g, 2 | ... | H g,N represents the sequence of gene embeddings from the Cell Encoder, which are projected into the LLM's input embedding space.

decisions.rationale: R6: the element explicitly states projection into the language model's input embedding space.
